# Conduct and Discretion
## Professional standards - You represent the Company at all times. Be courteous, composed and well presented. - Agreements are binding on the Company until the Company decides otherwise. - Keep records of every negotiation. Counsel decides what's kept on file. - Company information is Company property. Unauthorised disclosure ends your employment, and the Company decides the terms.
## Persuasion - The Company prefers agreement to conflict. Most people can be brought to agreement with the right incentive. - Incentives are recorded as Community Investment, consulting fees or hospitality. - Where an incentive fails, point out the consequences politely. Most people can be brought to agreement once they understand them. - A colonist who becomes an obstacle should be referred to Special Services rather than handled personally.
## Combat Office staff don't take part in hostilities. You may defend yourself and Company property. Leave everything else to Security and, where justified, to contractors.
## Liability The Company accepts no liability for the actions of employees acting outside procedure. It accepts even less for actions that were never recorded.
[italic]Thank you for choosing Weyland-Yutani.[/italic]
